prompt.en: Arriving at a well in the evening, Abraham's servant did the wisest thing a man on a hard errand can do: he ____.

prompt.en: As a sign, the right woman would offer to water the servant's ten thirsty ____, a task revealing a generous heart.
prompt.es: Como señal, la mujer correcta se ofrecería a dar agua a los diez ____ sedientos del siervo, una tarea que revelaría un corazón generoso.

prompt.en: Rebekah was chosen not for her beauty alone, but for her ____ heart.

prompt.es: Cuando le preguntaron si viajaría con el siervo para casarse con Isaac, Rebeca respondió: «Sí, ____».

prompt.en: Faith is not the absence of the unknown; it is the willingness to step into it on the strength of a trustworthy ____.
